request.user:
Subject: Physics
Question type: single-correct (exactly one option is right)

The half life period of a radioactive substance is 60 days. The time taken for \frac{7}{8} th of its original mass to disintegrate will be :
(A) 120 days
(B) 130 days
(C) 180 days
(D) 20 days

result.working: 7/8 of the mass disintegrates, so the fraction remaining is 1/8 = (1/2)^3. That takes 3 half-lives. Time = 3 × 60 days = 180 days.
